description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transform that outputs script tags for scripts collected to be loaded at the footer of a web page, based on the current HTTP request.

classes.name: ScriptTagsFooterTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to inject script tags into the footer of a web page based on request context.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a writer that, upon closing, writes out script tags collected for the end of the HTML body, based on the current HTTP request.
